text:
alejandra: FYI Canary for Prometheus9b int4 saw 2x OOMs this morning under default profile (batch=12, max_new_tokens=400). Hosts: us-east2-a.
tom: Any quick logs?
alejandra: snippet: ```
[E] oom alloc failed 2097152000
[warn] slab_frag_ratio=0.42
[info] gpu_mem_peak=39.2GB total=40GB
```
vik: slab_frag_ratio > 0.4 is the smoking gun. Prefetch + batch 12 likely made many small allocations stick.
alejandra: Proposed short-term: batch_size=6, max_new_tokens=192, prefetch=false, kv_trim_threshold=0.2. Rollout to canary only.
tom: +1. Also add slot_reserve=0.05 to smooth coldstarts.
ops-bot: deploy requested by alejandra (pool=prom-canary, commit=prom-int4-v2).
alejandra: Pushed changes. Config used: ```
serving.runtime.batch_size: 6
serving.runtime.max_new_tokens: 192
serving.runtime.prefetch: false
serving.runtime.kv_trim_threshold: 0.20
serving.runtime.slot_reserve: 0.05
```
vik: Watch metrics: slab_frag_ratio and free_slots. If frag stays >0.35 we should consider forcing a gc/compaction on idle.
tom: I'll queue an eval comparing generation quality between max_new 192 and 400 for long-form prompts (eval-suite: longform-coherency). ETA 4h.
alejandra: After change mem_peak down to ~36.1GB, no OOMs in 50m. Perf hit p95 +8% on long generations.
vik: Filed a tech debt ticket for allocator compaction (TICKET-2487). Long-term fix there.
alejandra: If canary clean for 4h we'll promote to dedicated with staged rollout. Thanks.
